title: Beyond Fixed Prompt Configuration: Alternating Policy Learning for Adaptive Topology-Based Prompting in Few-Shot Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Prompt Learning (GPL) adapts frozen pre-trained graph models to few-shot graph tasks through a small set of trainable prompts that encode task-specific information. Topology-based prompting instantiates this idea by augmenting an input graph with new prompt nodes and edges, yielding promising performance. However, prompt content and propagation structure are coupled, making it difficult to assess their individual effects and learn compatible configurations. In this paper, we empirically analyze two challenges in learning adaptive policies for topology-based prompting: asymmetric performance effects and coupled configuration selection. We then propose TTPR, a two-stage reinforcement framework that alternately optimizes two policies to generate adaptive configurations, with each policy conditioned on configurations generated by the other fixed policy. These conditional updates separate policy evaluation while preserving configuration

translated_title: 超越固定提示配置：面向少样本图学习中自适应拓扑提示的交替策略学习
translated_abstract: 图提示学习（GPL）通过一小组可训练的提示来编码任务特定信息，从而将冻结的预训练图模型适配到少样本图任务中。基于拓扑的提示通过为输入图添加新的提示节点和边来实现这一思想，取得了有前景的性能。然而，提示内容与传播结构是相互耦合的，这使得难以评估它们各自的效果并学习兼容的配置。在本文中，我们实证分析了在学习基于拓扑提示的自适应策略时面临的两个挑战：不对称的性能影响和耦合的配置选择。随后，我们提出了TTPR——一个两阶段强化学习框架，它交替优化两个策略以生成自适应配置，其中每个策略都以另一个固定策略所生成的配置为条件。这种条件式的更新方式在保持配置……（原文摘要在此处截断）的同时，实现了策略评估的分离。
tldr: 该论文提出TTPR两阶段强化学习框架，通过交替优化两个相互条件化的策略来解耦提示内容与传播结构，为少样本图学习中的拓扑提示生成自适应配置。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TTPR, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that alternately optimizes two mutually conditioned policies to decouple prompt content and propagation structure, generating adaptive configurations for topology-based prompting in few-shot graph learning.
